subject.title: fix(ollama): use CJK-aware char estimate for usage fallback

question: Should `estimateStringChars` become a stable public export of `openclaw/plugin-sdk/text-utility-runtime` for provider plugins, rather than remaining a core-only utility?
rationale: The implementation needs an approved plugin boundary: external plugin code cannot import core internals, and a new documented SDK export creates a long-lived compatibility contract.

options.title: Approve the narrow SDK export
options.body: Confirm that the existing CJK estimator is a supported stable utility for provider plugins, then require live Ollama fallback proof before merge.

options.title: Use a more specific plugin seam
options.body: Decline the general export and define a provider-oriented contract only if maintainers do not want this utility exposed across the SDK.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow SDK export
recommendation.body: Confirm that the existing CJK estimator is a supported stable utility for provider plugins, then require live Ollama fallback proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: A current plugin-SDK or Ollama-area owner must decide the permanent public contract; available review material does not identify one reliably.
